findings.summary: refreshBufferSeconds set to 6000 instead of the intended 600, a 10x error contradicting both the task brief and the inline comment.
findings.mechanism: The task asks for a 10-minute (600s) refresh window before expiry, and the comment literally says 'refresh 600s before expiry', but the value is 6000 (100 minutes). This makes Garmin tokens refresh nearly 1h40m before expiry instead of 10 minutes, and diverges from the test suite's GARMIN_BUFFER constant (600) added in the same commit, so production behavior no longer matches what the tests validate.
